reviews.title: Cancellation
reviews.text: How do I cancel my weekly subscription?
reviews.reply:
To cancel your subscription: Open Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions on your iPhone.

There you will see a list of all active and expired subscriptions. When you tap on a subscription from the list, you can choose a different subscription option or tap Cancel Subscription.

If you don’t see Cancel Subscription, the subscription is already canceled and won't renew. 

Here's a more detailed guide on that from Apple: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
